```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

Scatter plots relating eIF3d-dependent translation efficiency (si3d vs sictrl, 1hr
hypoxia) to changes in RIP-seq binding at 1hr hypoxia vs normoxia for:
1. eIF3d (FLAG-3d IP delta)
2. eIF4E IP delta

```{r constants}
TE_LFC_CUT <- 0.5
TE_PADJ_CUT <- 0.05

group_colors <- c(
  "eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = "#E69F00",
  "All other genes"        = "grey80"
)
```

```{r load}
te_path      <- here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv")
delta_3d_path <- here("ripseq", "output", "ripseq_deseq_flag3d_hypoxia_1hr_vs_normoxia_delta.csv")
delta_4e_path <- here("ripseq", "output", "ripseq_deseq_eif4e_hypoxia_1hr_vs_normoxia_delta.csv")

stopifnot(
  "Run TE DESeq2 analysis first" = file.exists(te_path),
  "Run notebook 09 to generate eIF3d delta CSV" = file.exists(delta_3d_path),
  "Run notebook 09 to generate eIF4E delta CSV" = file.exists(delta_4e_path)
)

te_df <- read_csv(te_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

delta_3d <- read_csv(delta_3d_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, delta_flag3d_lfc, delta_flag3d_padj)

delta_4e <- read_csv(delta_4e_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, delta_eif4e_lfc, delta_eif4e_padj)

cat("TE genes (1hr hypoxia):", nrow(te_df), "\n")
cat("eIF3d delta IP genes:", nrow(delta_3d), "\n")
cat("eIF4E delta IP genes:", nrow(delta_4e), "\n")
```

```{r join}
make_group <- function(df) {
  df |>
    mutate(
      group = if_else(
        te_lfc > TE_LFC_CUT & te_padj < TE_PADJ_CUT,
        "eIF3d hypoxia promotes", "All other genes"
      ),
      group = factor(group, levels = c("eIF3d hypoxia promotes", "All other genes"))
    )
}

plot_df_3d <- te_df |>
  inner_join(delta_3d, by = "gene_id_clean") |>
  filter(!is.na(te_lfc), !is.na(delta_flag3d_lfc)) |>
  make_group()

plot_df_4e <- te_df |>
  inner_join(delta_4e, by = "gene_id_clean") |>
  filter(!is.na(te_lfc), !is.na(delta_eif4e_lfc)) |>
  make_group()

cat("Plot df eIF3d IP rows:", nrow(plot_df_3d), "\n")
cat("Plot df eIF4E IP rows:", nrow(plot_df_4e), "\n")
plot_df_3d |> dplyr::count(group) |> print()
```

```{r scatter_eif3d_ip}
p_3d <- ggplot(plot_df_3d, aes(x = delta_flag3d_lfc, y = te_lfc)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group), alpha = 0.25, size = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    x     = "eIF3d binding change (log2FC, hypoxia vs normoxia, 1hr)",
    y     = "eIF3d-dependent TE (log2FC, hypoxia, 1hr)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "eIF3d binding change vs TE activity at 1hr hypoxia"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  xlim(-10,10)

ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "13_scatter_te_vs_eif3d_ip_delta_1hr.pdf"),
       p_3d, width = 6, height = 5)
p_3d
```

```{r scatter_eif4e_ip}
p_4e <- ggplot(plot_df_4e, aes(x = delta_eif4e_lfc, y = te_lfc)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = group), alpha = 0.25, size = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
  labs(
    x     = "eIF4E binding change (log2FC, hypoxia vs normoxia, 1hr)",
    y     = "eIF3d-dependent TE (log2FC, hypoxia, 1hr)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "eIF4E binding change vs eIF3d TE activity at 1hr hypoxia"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
    xlim(-10,10)


ggsave(here("ripseq", "plots", "13_scatter_te_vs_eif4e_ip_delta_1hr.pdf"),
       p_4e, width = 6, height = 5)
p_4e
```
